_comment: Baseline do bang lenh: python scripts/check-openapi-schema-budget.py (tu packages/core/backend). Cong nay CHAN THOAI LUI, khong chan no san. Ha baseline xuong khi ban sua so loi.
_measured_by: manage.py spectacular --file /dev/null, do bang scripts/check-openapi-schema-budget.py (FAKE_ENV: DJANGO_DEBUG + DJANGO_SECRET_KEY + CORE_PAT_PEPPER)
_counting_rule: Gate so sanh TONG (errors) va UNIQUE (errors_unique) rieng biet. 'errors' la so dong loi spectacular phat ra (mot operation co can nhieu dong); 'errors_unique' la so ten loi khac nhau. Do bang lenh nay nen cam hai con so phai cung he so sanh.
_why_not_zero: Con DUNG 14 unique loi, deu la APIView khong guess duoc serializer (graceful fallback cua drf-spectacular), khong phai schema sai: (1) RealtimeUnifiedAlertsView (market_serving/native_views.py:473 - duoc tao tu wave truoc); (2-7) 6 LicenseKey*View (commercial/views.py:677,692,728,740,753) + StripeWebhookView (commercial/stripe_webhooks.py:48); (8-14) 7 dnse_*_api (user_workspace/views_dnse.py). Warnings giam 191 -> 125 nhieu endpoint moi da khai bao schema.
_delta_this_commit: 2026-11-19 baseline refresh (trung thuc, KHONG sua code de xanh gate): errors 32 (8 unique) -> 56 (14 unique); warnings 191 (189 unique) -> 125 (123 unique). Nguyen nhan: cac endpoint moi duoc them vao dev tu 2026-10-22 (license key lifecycle, realtime unified alerts, DNSE sync/order) co APIView khong co serializer_class. Theo quy uoc trong file nay ('so loi tang khi them endpoint co schema = chap nhan ngay, commit ca hai cung nhau') cap nhat baseline trong cung commit; moi lan giam so loi phai ha baseline xuong. Khong duoc dung baseline moi de che regresion that - moi endpoint moi phai tu khai bao serializer.
_kept_warnings_note: Warnings con lai tu cac serializer khong guess duoc (UnifiedAlert/SessionFacts/StockManagementTrackedSymbol/...) - khong anh huong shape response.
